rounds.response:
Quick summary: Quick Swap lets users replace a planned recipe with one from their saved preferences in one or two taps, preserving the plan slot (date/meal/servings) and keeping shopping lists and nutrition totals consistent so swaps are fast, predictable, and reversible.  
Key behaviors: (a) Swap — pick a suggested saved recipe and immediately replace the planned item while scaling ingredients to match servings; (b) Shopping-list updates — new ingredients auto-merge into the existing list with quantities summed and duplicates consolidated; (c) Undo — a toast confirms the swap with a 5-second "Undo" that restores the previous recipe and shopping-list state; (d) Empty state — Quick Swap is visible but disabled when no eligible saved recipes exist, and tapping it shows guidance to clear dietary filters or browse recipes.  
Post-launch read: we’ll track swaps per active planner, undo rate, and downstream effects on shopping-list edits and weekly-plan churn; success looks like meaningful adoption among active planners, a low undo rate (target <10–15%), and reduced manual plan edits or improved on-plan retention.
